# Flexible Grouping Decision Tool

Subject: Differentiation and Special Education Support
Grade band: 3-5
Resource type: Planning Tool
NYS framework label: NYS Learning Standards with UDL-aligned access supports

## Short Description
A decision tool for grouping students by readiness, language need, interest, or strategy practice.

## Alignment Note
Supports differentiated planning while maintaining access to grade-level learning targets.

## Classroom Use Case
Use after exit tickets to plan tomorrow's small groups or partner structures.

## Preview Content
- Grouping purpose
- Evidence used
- How students will rejoin whole group learning

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
